name: A self-imscribing monad T on the category of Belnap-four-valued measurement algebras Meas_B4. Unit eta: X -> T(X) embeds a system into its measured completion (diagonal/inflation). Multiplication mu: T(T(X)) -> T(X) collapses double-measurement (orbit-collapse). Dialetheic closure mu o delta = id_A encodes the Sigma=1:1 self-referential fixed point where the grammar IS the measured system. The structure carries a Frobenius duality pairing the 6 dual primitive pairs (D<->T, R<->Phi, F<->K, G<->Gm, Ph<->H, Sigma<->Omega) and a chiral phase H from the winding Omega mod 2. The paraconsistent trace Tr_B4 on End_B4(A) is cyclic even under B (both-true-and-false) values, which is the arcane core: classical trace fails under contradiction but this trace survives because mu o delta = id.
